description: Archive a segment to hide it from the default segment catalog and new audience compositions, or restore an archived one back to active. Archiving changes where the segment can be used; restoring it is a separate action. Archiving does not affect audiences that already reference this segment — their composition and record count are unchanged. This is distinct from permanently deleting a segment, which does change referencing audiences' composition and cannot be undone. Requires the creator scope. Requires 'creator' scope.

restore.description: Pass true to restore an archived segment back to active instead of archiving it

segment_id.description: The segment ID to archive or restore
